title: Keep to the activity limits of marine park zones
what: Carry out an activity that a marine park zone prohibits or restricts (such as commercial filming or research in some zones) only as the zoning regulations allow or under a permit.

sources.title: Marine Parks Act 2007 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: a person must not contravene a provision of the regulations prohibiting or restricting activities within a zone of a marine park

sources.quote: The Minister may grant a permit to a person to engage in an activity within a marine park, or a zone or other area of a marine park, that would otherwise be prohibited or restricted under Division 3.
